paragraphs: Mentioned in [Sotah 41b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.41b.8), expounding that it is permitted to flatter the wicked in this world, as it is said, etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Sotah has בעולם הזה, “in this world,” where the supplied Hebrew has בע״הן. It names Rabbi Yehudah bar Maarava and gives Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi as an alternative speaker.

מא: gives Sotah 41b. The permitted-to-flatter teaching is reported as the source’s statement, not contemporary advice. As-it-is-said etc. retains Hyman’s elided proof-text rather than importing the named passage’s full verse.
